Segundo Sol

A community-centered collective fostering intentional gatherings and conscious music experiences.

We nurture authentic community through the healing power of music and intentional gathering, creating containers for meaningful artistic expression.

Curating and releasing ambient, healing, and conscious music
Organizing gatherings and immersive experiences
Supporting conscious artists and receptive communities
Integrating healing modalities with musical experiences

Music as medicine.
Community as healing.

From intimate listening sessions to expansive experiences, we create spaces where people can be fully themselves and express their truth without judgment.
